scripts.text:
[Librarian]
What are you doing?
Don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你在做什麼？
別亂碰東西！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should read this
from the point where
I left off...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
接著上次沒讀完的地方看吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
What's this mark
here at the bottom?
Some kind of secret?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
底下這個記號是什麼？
難道藏著什麼秘密？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No wonder the librarian
seemed to hesitate before
saying anything. Huh.
Now let's see...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難怪圖書管理員開口前會猶豫。
嗯，來看看...

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^663300Lowen, of the 2nd squad, returned to her detachment 3 days after the incident. A trial was held, and she was judged guilty of fleeing when ordered to fight.^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300第二小隊的洛溫於事件發生3天后歸隊。
經審判，認定其犯有違抗作戰命令、臨陣脫逃之罪。^000000

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^663300Despite the severity of this offense, she was only discharged from the Crusaders and the holy power granted to her was forcibly removed...^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300儘管罪行嚴重，最終僅將其逐出十字軍，並強行剝奪了賜予她的神聖力量...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She was forced to leave the Crusaders?! That's ridiculous!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
居然把她逐出了十字軍？！
太荒唐了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did they want to sentence her to death or what? That's almost too cruel. She must have been humiliated...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這跟判她死刑有什麼兩樣？
也太殘忍了。
她一定受盡了屈辱...

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^6633002 years later after the incident, an expedition team found rusty armor shards, a broken sword
and some effects belonging to
Lowen Ellenen.^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300事件發生2年後，一支探險隊發現了屬於洛溫·艾萊南的鏽蝕盔甲碎片、一把斷劍及其他遺物。^000000

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^663300However, this information
is highly classified. Officially, Lowen Ellenen died during the mission.^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300但此事被列為高度機密。
官方記錄為洛溫·艾萊南於任務中陣亡。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They thought she brought
disgrace to the Crusaders?
This sounds pretty messy.
Should I try to meet her again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們覺得她讓十字軍蒙羞了？
這件事真複雜。
要不要再去見她一次呢？

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
^666666*Yawn...*^000000
What the...?
who are you!
Get the hell
out of here!

[Librarian]
^666666*Yawn...*^000000
What the...?
who are you!
Get the hell
out of here!
^3355FFYou took the book from the shelf while the librarian was dozing. According to the Crusader Personnel Records, there's only one recruit that was named Lowen Ellenen.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF趁圖書管理員打盹時，你從書架上取下了那本書。
根據十字軍人事檔案，名叫洛溫·艾萊南的新兵只有一位。

Member of the
2nd squad...
Age 22...
Female...
scripts.translation:

洛溫·艾萊南...
第二小隊成員...
年齡22歲...
女性...

information the

這跟圖書管理員告訴我的不一樣！
